player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} ku-Nim. Inhloso yakho ukuthatha into yokugcina esele. Ekuphendukeni ngakunye, khetha inqwaba eyodwa bese ususa into eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kuyo. Sebenzisa ifomethi '[pile quantity]', lapho inqwaba iyinkomba yenqwaba futhi ubuningi buyinombolo yezinto okufanele zisuswe. Isibonelo, '[0 3]' kususa izinto ezi-3 kusuka kunqwaba 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ayikho ifomethi yokuhambisa evumelekile etholakele. Sebenzisa u-'[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Umdlali {player_id}, Isenzo esingekho emthethweni. Ikholomu {col} ingaphandle kwemingcele.

observation.removed_from_piles: Mdlali {player_id} udlale '[{pile_index} {quantity}]', esusa {quantity} into (noma izinto) kusikhala {pile_index}.
